23108.d: Senntisten, also known as "Holy City", was the capital city of the Zarosian Empire, which existed during the Second and Third Ages.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• The Pontifex shadow ring, restored after the City of Senntisten quest, can teleport the player directly to the cathedral.
• Use the Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Guild, then walk north to the ancient door (dungeon), east to the ancient doors (The Empty Throne Room) or north-east to a winch (Senntisten Temple).
• Using a gnome glider to fly to Lemanto Andra (3) leaves the player very close to the ancient door.
• The dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild, archaeology teleport or the master archaeologist's outfit can be used to teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site camp just north-east of the cathedral, provided the player has level 60 scm | Archaeology Archaeology or access to those items.
• The boss portal in War's Retreat (requiring at least one kill of Kerapac, the bound, Arch-Glacor or Croesus or the boss portal in the Max Guild (not requiring the kill) can be attuned to teleport the player to one of the fronts of the dungeon.
• Dig Site pendant can be used to teleport to the following:
• Varrock Dig Site - Archaeologist's workbench & Bank chest, walk north-west to the ancient door.
• Senntisten Temple - north-west winch entrance to temple.
• Skeletal horror Teleport can be used to teleport to the north-east of the ancient door.

23115.d: The Senntisten Asylum is a dungeon that can be found in Senntisten.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The Senntisten asylum can be entered by operating the asylum elevator to the north-east of Senntisten Cathedral.

Options to reach the asylum include:
• Teleport directly into the asylum using the Mask of the Abyss or Helm of Warping.
• Teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site, then head north to the elevator.
• Using the master archaeologist's outfit teleport
• Teleport to the Archaeology Campus using the archaeology journal, then use the dig sites map inside the Archaeology Guild (requires 60 Archaeology)
• Teleport to Senntisten using the pontifex shadow ring, then run north-east to the elevator.
• Teleport to the TzekHaar Front or the Zamorakian Undercity via War's Retreat or the Max Guild, leave the Senntisten sewers and run north-east to the elevator.
• Through Senntisten ancient door, then run to the east. Options to reach the ancient door include:
• Teleport to the Varrock Dig Site using the Dig Site pendant or archaeology journal and then run north to the ancient door.
• Use Skeletal horror Teleport or Fort Forinthry lodestone to King's Road, then run south-west to the ancient door.
• Use an invitation box to teleport to the Empyrean Citadel and again return to the Gielinor surface, then run south-west to the ancient door.

23116.d: The Senntisten Dig Site is a mini-dig site located in Senntisten, requiring level 60 Archaeology to be interacted with.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Any of the following may be used to get to Senntisten Dig Site.
• Pontifex shadow ring: Teleport to the cathedral. The cathedral is in the south-eastern Senntisten Dig Site.
• Archaeology journal: Teleport to Archaeology Campus, use the dig sites map in Archaeology Guild in the west and select Senntisten. Leads to the eastern Senntisten Dig Site.
• Master archaeologist's outfit: While wearing full outfit, right click on master archaeologist's hat, and teleport to Senntisten. Leads to the eastern Senntisten Dig Site.
• Gnome glider: Fly to Lemanto Andra, leading just west of the Varrock Dig Site. Walk north-east to the ancient door. Leads to the north-eastern Senntisten Dig Site.
• Dig Site pendant: Teleport using the following options.
• Varrock Dig Site: Walk north-west to the ancient door. Leads to the north-eastern Senntisten Dig Site.
• Varrock Dig Site: Walk west, use the dig sites map in Archaeology Guild, and teleport to Senntisten. Leads to the eastern Senntisten Dig Site.
• Senntisten Temple: Walk west to the ancient door. Leads to the north-eastern Senntisten Dig Site.
• Boss portal attuned to Kerapac, the bound: Leads to the western Senntisten Dig Site.
• Reaper portal with assignment for Kerapac, the bound: Leads to the western Senntisten Dig Site.

23119.d: Senntisten sewers are the main area of the TzekHaar Front of the Elder God Wars Dungeon in Senntisten, accessible through a chasm to the north of the cathedral.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The Senntisten sewers can be entered in the northern section of Senntisten, which can be accessed by the ancient door north of the Archaeology Guild and directly east of Tolna's rift. In the middle of the TzekHaar Front there is a large chasm with chains enabling the player to climb down to sewers. Entering the sewers for the first time triggers a cutscene.

Travel methods include:
• Use the Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Guild, then walk north to the ancient door.
• Using a gnome glider to fly to Lemanto Andra (3) leaves the player very close to the ancient door.
• The pontifex shadow ring, restored after the City of Senntisten quest, can teleport the player directly to the cathedral, south of the entrance.
• The dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild, Archaeology teleport or the master archaeologist's outfit can be used to teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site camp just south-east of the entrance to the sewers, provided the player has level 60 scm | Archaeology Archaeology or access to those items.
• The boss portal in War's Retreat (requiring at least one kill of TzKal-Zuk) or the boss portal in the Max Guild (not requiring the kill) can be attuned to teleport the player to TzKal-Zuk.
• For a limited time after the front's release, fateful portal (TzKal-Zuk) in War's Retreat.

start.how: {{Object map}} on wiki page 'Senntisten', section 'Getting there' (the infobox on 'Senntisten sewers' gives its location as 'Senntisten')
start.label: Senntisten

23120.d: Senntisten Temple is a temple found under the Varrock Dig Site.

gt.heading: Transportation
gt.text:
There are five ways of getting to the Temple:
# Use a Dig Site pendant
# Use a gnome glider from the Grand Tree to destination Lemanto Andra
# Use the Senntisten Teleport from the Ancient Magicks spellbook
# Walk from Varrock or Al Kharid to the Varrock Dig Site
#Use the Archaeology Journal and run north

The two parts of the dungeon are in different locations with respect to one another that you would expect from their surface entrances. The northeast winch leads to the chamber that is south-west of the west winch's entrance point. Use the winch at the western part of the Varrock Dig Site to enter the Temple.

23193.d: Shades of Mort'ton is a multi-part minigame unlocked after completing the Shades of Mort'ton quest, in which players perform the various tasks involved in cremating shades.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• After levelling Zachory Bragg to level 99 in Temple Trekking the trapdoor behind the Hair of the Dog tavern in Canifis takes players directly to Mort'ton.
• A games necklace can be used to teleport to the nearby town of Burgh de Rott after unlocking the destination by playing Temple Trekking.
• Drakan's medallion can be used to teleport to the Barrows or Burgh de Rott (requires partial completion of The Branches of Darkmeyer).
• Teleport to the Barrows via a boss portal.
• A Swamp Boat can be taken directly to Mort'ton from the Hollows in the Mort Myre Swamp. The boat can be reached by the following methods:
• From Canifis via the tunnel behind the Hair of the Dog tavern (after In Search of the Myreque)
• From the BKR fairy ring in the Mort Myre Swamp.
• Running south from Canifis through Mort Myre Swamp. The northwestern gate requires starting the Nature Spirit quest.

gt.heading: Accessibility
gt.text:
Partial completion of Nature Spirit allows you to pass through the gate southwest of Canifis into the Mort Myre Swamp, and access Mort'ton to the south. Fairy ring AnchorText | BKR | BKR teleports you just south of the gate. Otherwise, players have to enter the south side of the Haunted Woods, and find the passage into the east swamp. There is a passage from the east swamp to the west swamp through the wall of weeds which will require a great deal of wandering around in the east swamp to get to. Once in the west swamp heading south through the winding path will finally bring the player to Mort'ton. 

However, completing In Aid of the Myreque is strongly recommended, as it gives players access to the local bank in Burgh de Rott to the south, without which players will have to trek all the way back and forth from Canifis on every trip. Partial completion of The Branches of Darkmeyer gives access to a Burgh de Rott teleport using Drakan's medallion, which will further speed up banking trips.

It is highly recommended to use serum 208 on Razmire Keelgan and Ulsquire Shauncy as soon as possible for assistance, trading, and supplies.
